name: Overdue Support Tickets
query:
SELECT
	`tabSupport Ticket`.name AS `Ticket:Link/Support Ticket:160`,
	`tabSupport Ticket`.subject AS `Subject:Data:200`,
	`tabSupport Ticket`.customer AS `Customer:Link/Customer:140`,
	`tabSupport Ticket`.status AS `Status:Data:120`,
	`tabSupport Ticket`.resolution_due AS `Resolution Due:Datetime:160`,
	`tabSupport Ticket`.is_overdue AS `Overdue:Check:80`
FROM `tabSupport Ticket`
WHERE `tabSupport Ticket`.is_overdue = 1
	AND `tabSupport Ticket`.status NOT IN ('Resolved', 'Closed', 'Cancelled')
ORDER BY `tabSupport Ticket`.resolution_due ASC
LIMIT 500
